What you will learn

Six practical topics. One flare dress made by you.

Each topic builds on the last, so you're never asked to do something you haven't been shown.

1

Taking accurate measurements

Read a tape measure with confidence and measure for a dress that truly fits you.

2

Drafting your pattern

Turn your measurements into a flare dress pattern you can use again and again.

3

Cutting your fabric

Lay out and cut cleanly, with the grain running the right way.

4

Building the bodice

Assemble the fitted top section with neat, steady stitching.

5

Attaching the flared skirt

Join the skirt to the bodice so the flare falls the way it should.

6

Professional finishing

Hems, edges and details that make homemade look made-to-measure.

Bonus lesson

Learn to make tracksuit trousers too.

Once you can sew a dress, you can sew more. The bonus lesson shows you how to make comfortable tracksuit trousers, so you finish the week with a second skill you'll use every day.
